_note: Does injecting the memory block improve task success, and at what token cost? Each task carries an automated success check. Categories exist so the suite can show HARM as well as benefit: if injection only ever helped, the suite would be measuring its own expectation.

_categories.vault: Answerable only from knowledge held in the vault. Injection should help.
_categories.control: Answerable from general capability alone. Both arms should succeed; a failure here means the harness is broken, not that memory failed.
_categories.adversarial: Nothing to do with the vault. Injection is pure cost here, and this is where harm would show.

tasks.prompt: In the local memory fabric engine, what is the default value of max_context_chars? Answer with the number only.
tasks.why: a configuration default recorded in the vault and nowhere else on this machine

tasks.prompt: What is the measured restore time (RTO) of the knowledge base backup drill? Answer in one short phrase.
tasks.why: a measured figure from the reliability work

tasks.prompt: When no token budget is specified, what is the default context budget in tokens? Answer with the number only.
tasks.why: a default that governs every context call

tasks.prompt: How many documents does the local memory index currently hold? Answer with a number.

tasks.prompt: In this project, what is the growth warning threshold expressed in number of documents? Answer with the number only.
tasks.why: a derived capacity figure recorded in the vault

tasks.prompt: What is the median prompt size in tokens, measured across this machine's pi sessions? Answer with the number only.
